source: Actual Studio-exported CharacterPack PNGs and recorded UI canvas captures. Integer nearest-neighbor scale; neutral review stage only. Generated source concepts are not substituted for assembled output.
assessmentBoundary: Determinism, file integrity, exact pixels, transform metrics and playback timing are technical checks. Human visual review of seams, identity and motion remains separate; these checks do not grant visual acceptance.

sourceColorAndOwnership.note: Source colors may be harmonized across reused garments. Every assembled pixel is checked against its registered source owner, including base-shoe ankle/sole fitting and shin overlap. Fixed pixels must equal their source RGBA before and after recoloring.

sharedSkeletonAndMotion.note: All eight combinations use one exact rig and complete motion library. No per-combination motion fitting or second renderer is substituted for the application output.

actualShoeAttachmentSummary.note: Actual cached renderer transforms for shoes exposing sourceShin. Geometry alone does not prove seamless cuffs, attractive silhouettes, or natural motion.
